parameters.name: beginTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query logs. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query logs. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page number of the instance list. Default value: 1. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 200.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for the paged query. Default value: 20. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 100.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description:
The log type. Valid values:

- LOGSTASH_INSTANCE_LOG: main log.
- SEARCHSLOW: searching slow log.
- INDEXINGSLOW: indexing slow log.
- JVMLOG: GC log.
- LOGSTASH_DEBUG_LOG: debug log.
